how: We read the website of every Detroit wedding florist listed on Lazo (188 listings, 156 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day delivery shops, two bouquet preservation studios, a garden center and a grocery store, a flower farm with a mobile bar, and Windsor-side decorators. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What is in season in Michigan for my month, and what has to be shipped in when it is February?
Do you design for the venue, or deliver arrangements? Installation and teardown are the difference in price.
Can I see a full wedding's florals, not a bouquet photo, at a budget like mine?

picks.name: Bellisario Florist
picks.blurb: A family-owned Eastpointe florist with over 60 years of experience, where Ralph and Jennie meet clients and a large share of the business is weddings of all sizes. Beyond flowers they do linens, lighting and backdrops, and the site posts a list of vendors they recommend.

picks.name: Flora Rae - Floral Design Studio
picks.blurb: Flora Rae sources the freshest blooms from local growers for custom wedding and event florals, from bouquets to full installations. The Dexter studio designs in Ann Arbor, Detroit and northern Michigan, and describes its style as romantic.

picks.name: J Costello Designs
picks.blurb: A third-generation florist who grew up watching bouquets made in the back room of a great-grandmother's shop, Alma Boyd Florist in Detroit, J. Costello Designs is a lifestyle and event florist in Royal Oak. Wedding and event floral sits alongside gift bouquets you can shop online.

picks.name: Petit Fleur Events
picks.blurb: Petit Fleur Events is a boutique, female-owned studio in Ferndale that puts floral design, event coordinating, decor and linens under one roof as an all-inclusive planning experience. Full Service Floral Design is pitched as a one-on-one design process, working Metro Detroit and Northern Michigan.

picks.name: Stem Event Design I Twigs & Branches Floral
picks.blurb: Opened in January 2009 as Twigs and Branches Floral and recently rebranded as Stem Event Design, Kevin Miller's Rochester Hills studio does full-service custom event and floral design. It caters to luxury events in Metro Detroit and throughout Michigan.

picks.name: Michael B. Anthony
picks.blurb: Michael B. Anthony is a floral design studio and flower farm on Clay Street in Detroit, creating event artistry and growing flowers for Michiganders and beyond. Weddings and event design are the two services, with the founder introduced on the site.

picks.name: Olive's Bloombox
picks.blurb: Olive's Bloombox calls itself Metro Detroit's premier wedding florist and does floral and event design for weddings and social events plus workshops, from a shop in Ferndale. Custom designs can be picked up or delivered within 20 miles, and each event is managed by the shop.

picks.name: Posie Pink's Flower Boutique
picks.blurb: Sara Conklin has designed flowers since 2011 and in 2019 acquired the wedding floral business formerly known as Parsonage Events, which turned Posie Pink's into an event-focused studio specializing in custom design. The boutique is in Oxford.

picks.name: Soirée Event & Floral
picks.blurb: Sarah decorated her own small outdoor wedding during COVID and built Soiree Event & Floral in Dearborn from that experience. The pitch is a seamless one-stop solution for all decor needs, with draping, floral design and rentals included.

picks.name: Bridal Insignia Events
picks.blurb: Bridal Insignia is a Metro Detroit wedding decorator in Warren crafting fresh florals, centerpieces and cultural ceremonies, and its site walks venue by venue through rooms it knows, from San Marino Club and Meadow Brook Hall to the Bharatiya Temple. Pricing has a page of its own.

picks.name: Lily's
picks.blurb: A little flower shop in Saline inspired by the open-air markets of Paris, with a changing assortment of blooms each week. Lily's does weddings alongside funerals and everyday orders, so it is the shop option rather than a design studio, two blocks off Michigan Avenue.
